message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to make live API calls from here.  
To get the CNAME record IDs for `sample.com` you can run a request similar to this:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records?record_type=CNAME" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123"
```

The response will contain a list of objects; each object has an `"id"` field.  
Extract those `"id"` values (e.g., using `jq`):

```bash
curl -s -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records?record_type=CNAME" \
     -H "x-apikey: secret123" | jq -r '.data[].id'
```

That command prints only the IDs of the CNAME records.
